articles.title: 术中低剂量静脉艾司氯胺酮用于急性术后疼痛控制的疗效：随机对照试验的Meta分析
articles.originalTitle: Efficacy of intraoperative low dose intravenous Esketamine for acute postoperative pain control: Meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
articles.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the effect of intraoperative low-dose intravenous esketamine (<1 mg/kg) on acute postoperative pain, opioid consumption, adverse events, and anesthetic requirements through a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. METHODS: We systematically searched PubMed, Cochrane Central, and Embase (to Apr 28, 2025) for RCTs on intraoperative low dose IV esketamine (<1 mg/kg) for acute postoperative pain. Data was analyzed in R using mean differences or risk ratios (95% CIs). Risk of bias followed Cochrane methods. Sensitivity used leave-one-out and meta-regression. RESULTS: Thirty-five RCTs (3831 patients; 1663 control, 2168 esketamine) showed low-dose IV esketamine significantly reduced pain at rest at 4 h (MD -1.40; p < 0.0001), 12 h (-0.84; p < 0.0001), 24 h (-0.54; p < 0.0001), and 48 h (-0.39; p = 0.0014). Pain on movement was lower at 12 h (-0.62; p = 0.0111), 24 h (-0.63; p = 0.0003) and 48 h (MD -0.40, 95% CI -0.74 to -0.06; p = 0.0212; I(2) = 75.5%). No significant differences in overall or individual adverse events (nausea, agitation, dizziness, hallucinations) were observed between groups. Postoperative morphine consumption was reduced at 4, 24 and 48 h, with no significant difference at 12 h. Rescue analgesia requirements were reduced (RR 0.52; p = 0.0001), and intraoperative propofol use was modestly lower (-18.47 mg; p = 0.0047). No significant dose-response relationship was identified (p = 0.0571). CONCLUSION: Intraoperative low-dose esketamine modestly reduces postoperative pain at rest (4-48 h) and during movement (12-48 h), decreases opioid and rescue analgesia requirements, and slightly lowers propofol use. However, the magnitude and consistency of these effects are uncertain due to heterogeneity and study limitations. Adverse events did not differ significantly, though evidence remains limited. Esketamine may be considered as an adjunct in perioperative pain management with appropriate monitoring.
articles.authors: Majeed E, Rafique I, Inam K, Majeed F

articles.title: 让手术安全核对表更安全：在切皮前使用团队暂停核对表改善信息交换和跨专业沟通
articles.originalTitle: Making the Surgical Safety Checklist Even Safer: A Team Timeout Checklist to Improve Information Exchange and Interprofessional Communication Before Skin Incision.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: The World Health Organization surgical safety checklist (WHO SSC) provides a standardized framework for preoperative safety procedures. However, studies have revealed substantial variation in adherence, with items being skipped or misunderstood and nurses likely to be less involved than other operating room (OR) professional groups. We introduce a 16-item team timeout checklist (TTOC) that clarifies and adds safety-critical items to the existing WHO before skin incision timeout and is led by nurses to improve information exchange, closed-loop communication, and encouraging participation of all professional groups. METHODS: Using a prospective pre-post interventional design, we live-coded all team communication during on-site observations in the OR focusing on the pre-incision phase. Surgical teams were first observed during a pre-intervention period without the TTOC checklist and subsequently during a post-intervention period after implementation of the TTOC checklist. The TTOC was evaluated on four communication outcomes critical for patient safety: information exchange of checklist items, measured as the percentage of the 16 items that were verbally communicated among team members (eg, team introduction, surgical site, allergies), participation rates of different professional groups, frequency of explicit coordination behaviors (eg, instruction, information request, speaking up) and the frequency of closed-loop communication sequences, defined as information request followed by information upon request within 30 seconds. RESULTS: A total of 155 teams were observed, including 78 teams in the pre-intervention phase without TTOC use and 77 teams in the post-intervention phase using the TTOC, resulting in 13,127 coded communication events. The median information exchange increased from 62.5% (interquartile range [IQR] 50-68.8) in the pre-intervention phase to 100% (IQR 100-100) in the post-intervention phase (P < .001). For 15 of all 16 subitems, the odds of exchanging information were significantly higher after TTOC implementation than before TTOC implementation (odds ratios range 10.8-1896, all 95% confidence intervals [CIs] excluded 1). Participation rates increased for circulating nurses, scrub nurses, surgical residents, and anesthesia (all P < .05) but not for lead surgeons. Mean (standard deviation [SD]) closed-loop communication patterns per operation were more frequent with (20.4 [10.7]) than without the TTOC (16.4, [7.24]), P = .004. CONCLUSIONS: In our study, the nurse-led TTOC significantly improved the exchange of safety-critical items during the pre-incision phase, facilitated closed-loop communication, and empowered the participation of various professional groups. These findings suggest integrating the TTOC with the WHO SSC before-incision protocol may have important advantages.
articles.authors: Weiss M, Reimer C, Budnitskiy A, Kleber C, Stehr SN, Piegeler T

articles.question: 手术安全核对表的使用常存在执行变异，TTOC通过明确条目和护士主导提高了信息交换的完整性，可能降低沟通失误风险，但需进一步研究确认其对患者预后的改善作用。
articles.conclusion: 本前瞻性前后干预研究显示，由护士主导的16项团队暂停核对表（TTOC）显著提高了切皮前安全关键信息的交换率（从62.5%升至100%），促进了闭环沟通，并增强了除主刀医生外各专业群体的参与度，但尚未评估对临床结局的影响。
articles.clinical: TTOC提高了麻醉医生在核对过程中的参与率，但主刀医生参与未显著改善，提示需额外策略促进外科领导参与。 闭环沟通的增加可能减少信息遗漏，对术中麻醉管理有潜在益处。 研究未评估对临床结局（如并发症、死亡率）的影响，因此麻醉医生应审慎解读，避免过度推断临床获益。

keyPoints: 护士主导的16项TTOC将切皮前信息交换率从62.5%提升至100%。
15/16项目的沟通几率显著增加（OR 10.8-1896，95% CI均排除1）。

articles.methods: 世界卫生组织手术安全核对表（WHO SSC）为术前安全程序提供了标准化框架，但研究显示其遵循率存在显著变异，条目被跳过或误解，护士参与度低于其他手术室专业群体。为此，研究者设计了一份16项团队暂停核对表（TTOC），在原有WHO SSC切皮前暂停环节基础上澄清并增加了安全关键条目，由护士主导，旨在改善信息交换、闭环沟通并鼓励所有专业群体参与。
articles.results: 共观察155个手术团队（前干预78队，后干预77队），记录了13,127个编码沟通事件。信息交换中位数从前干预期的62.5%（IQR 50-68.8）增至后干预期的100%（IQR 100-100）（P<0.001）。16项子条目中15项的信息交换几率在TTOC实施后显著升高（OR范围10.8-1896，所有95% CI均排除1）。巡回护士、洗手护士、外科住院医师和麻醉医生的参与率均增加（均P<0.05），但主刀医生的参与率无显著变化。每台手术闭环沟通模式均值在TTOC组为20.4（SD 10.7），对照组为16.4（SD 7.24），P=0.004。
limitations: 单中心前后设计，可能存在时间混杂因素和霍桑效应。
未盲法观察者，可能引入观察偏倚。
未报告不良事件或临床结局，无法确定TTOC对患者预后的直接改善作用。
主刀医生参与率未显著提高，可能是沟通改善的瓶颈。
practice: TTOC提高了麻醉医生在核对过程中的参与率，但主刀医生参与未显著改善，提示需额外策略促进外科领导参与。
闭环沟通的增加可能减少信息遗漏，对术中麻醉管理有潜在益处。
研究未评估对临床结局（如并发症、死亡率）的影响，因此麻醉医生应审慎解读，避免过度推断临床获益。
articles.editor: 该研究提供了中等至强有力的证据，表明护士主导的TTOC可显著改善手术团队信息交换和沟通质量，但缺乏随机对照和临床结局终点。 过度解读风险：中等。作者结论强调了TTOC的优势，但未提及对主刀医生参与无改善的局限性，且未报告临床获益。读者应避免将沟通改善直接等同于患者安全改善。

articles.title: 经鼻湿化快速吹入通气交换（THRIVE）对肥胖患者控制性呼吸暂停期间肺容量动态的生理影响：一项随机对照试验
articles.originalTitle: Physiological effects of trans-nasal humidified rapid insufflation ventilatory exchange (THRIVE) on lung volume dynamics during controlled apnea in patients with obesity: a randomized controlled trial.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Obese patients are prone to rapid oxygen desaturation during induction of general anesthesia due to reduced functional residual capacity and atelectasis formation. Transnasal humidified rapid insufflation ventilatory exchange (THRIVE) prolongs safe apnea time; however, its effects on lung volume dynamics during apnea remain unclear. METHODS: In this single-center randomized controlled trial, adults with body mass index >/=35 kg/m(2) undergoing elective surgery were assigned to apneic oxygenation with THRIVE or facemask oxygen following induction of general anesthesia. Electrical impedance tomography was used to assess changes in end-expiratory lung impedance (DeltaEELI), a surrogate of lung volume. The primary outcome was mean global DeltaEELI during an early apneic window (2-6 min). RESULTS: Thirty-two patients were analyzed. Mean global DeltaEELI during early apnea was significantly better preserved with THRIVE than with facemask oxygen (-0.22 +/- 0.03 vs. -0.89 +/- 0.07; mean difference 0.67, 95% CI 0.55-0.80; P < 0.001). THRIVE attenuated the rate of DeltaEELI decline and was associated with greater preservation of lung volume, particularly in mid-ventral and mid-dorsal regions. Safe apnea time was significantly prolonged in the THRIVE group (median 600 vs. 319 s). CONCLUSIONS: In obese patients, THRIVE transiently preserves lung volume during early apnea by slowing the decline in end-expiratory lung volume. articles.title: 全麻联合区域麻醉与单纯全麻对择期骨科大手术患者功能恢复的影响：一项基于全国医院索赔数据库的目标试验模拟研究
articles.originalTitle: Functional impairment in patients undergoing major orthopaedic surgery under general anaesthesia with or without regional anaesthesia: a target trial emulation using a national hospital claims database.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: We evaluated whether combined general and regional anaesthesia (GA+RA) was associated with improvements in activities of daily living compared with GA alone in adult patients having major orthopaedic surgery. METHODS: This target trial emulation used data from the Japanese Diagnosis Procedure Combination system (April 1, 2016-December 31, 2023) for patients undergoing major orthopaedic surgery. The primary outcome was discharge-anchored functional change, defined as the difference in the Barthel Index scores between admission and discharge, among admissions with observed and comparable discharge Barthel Index scores. We conducted stabilised inverse probability of treatment weighting using preoperative covariates, and weighted linear regression models were fitted. Secondary outcomes included in-hospital mortality and postoperative length of stay. Missing data were handled using multiple imputations, and sensitivity analyses (inverse probability of censoring weighting, subgroup analyses, and complete case analysis) were performed. RESULTS: A total of 244 212 patients received GA+RA (peripheral nerve block: 183 564; epidural anaesthesia: 60 648) and 435 462 patients received GA alone. After propensity score weighting, GA+RA yielded a higher change in Barthel Index scores (mean difference 0.73, 95% confidence interval [CI] 0.57-0.88, P<0.001), shorter postoperative length of stay (-1.40 days, 95% CI -1.45 to -1.35, P<0.001) and lower in-hospital mortality (hazard ratio 0.85, 95% CI 0.76-0.96, P=0.006). Sensitivity analyses yielded directionally consistent findings. CONCLUSIONS: Combined general and regional anaesthesia was associated clinically with modest improvements in discharge-anchored functional change, postoperative stay and in-hospital mortality. Residual confounding and heterogeneity of regional anaesthesia techniques warrant cautious interpretation and prospective confirmation.

articles.question: 该研究通过目标试验模拟设计，在大样本真实世界数据中评估了联合麻醉对术后日常活动能力的影响，为围术期麻醉方式的选择提供了临床参考。
articles.conclusion: 对于接受骨科大手术的成人患者，与单纯全麻相比，全麻联合区域麻醉可能与出院时功能改善（Barthel指数变化均值差0.73, 95%CI 0.57-0.88, P<0.001）、术后住院时间缩短（-1.40天, 95%CI -1.45至-1.35, P<0.001）以及院内死亡率降低（HR 0.85, 95%CI 0.76-0.96, P=0.006）相关联。
articles.clinical: 本研究提示全麻联合区域麻醉可能在骨科大手术中带来轻微的临床获益，包括功能改善、住院时间缩短和死亡率降低。 区域麻醉技术（外周神经阻滞与硬膜外麻醉）的异质性需进一步区分。

study.value: 目标试验模拟研究（基于日本诊断程序组合数据库，2016年4月1日至2023年12月31日），采用稳定的逆概率治疗加权和加权线性回归模型，多重插补处理缺失数据，并进行敏感性分析（逆概率删失加权、亚组分析、完整病例分析）。

articles.methods: 既往研究多关注区域麻醉对镇痛和并发症的影响，但对其是否能改善患者术后日常活动能力尚不明确。本研究利用日本诊断程序组合数据库模拟目标试验，比较全麻联合区域麻醉与单纯全麻在骨科大手术患者中的效果。
articles.results: 纳入679,674例患者（联合麻醉组244,212例，单纯全麻组435,462例）。倾向性评分加权后，联合麻醉组Barthel指数变化均值差0.73（95%CI 0.57-0.88, P<0.001），术后住院时间缩短-1.40天（95%CI -1.45至-1.35, P<0.001），院内死亡率HR 0.85（95%CI 0.76-0.96, P=0.006）。敏感性分析结果方向一致。
limitations: 残余混杂和区域麻醉技术的异质性需谨慎解释，并需前瞻性研究确认。
数据库未提供区域麻醉的具体技术细节（如单次注射、连续给药等），可能影响结果的外推性。

区域麻醉技术（外周神经阻滞与硬膜外麻醉）的异质性需进一步区分。

articles.title: 高海拔手术患者术前血红蛋白与术中氧饱和度降低的性别特异性非线性关联：一项回顾性观察性研究
articles.originalTitle: Sex-Specific Nonlinear Association Between Preoperative Hemoglobin and Intraoperative Oxygen Desaturation in High-Altitude Surgical Patients: A Retrospective Observational Study.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: High hemoglobin concentration is a compensatory adaptation to high-altitude hypoxia that theoretically increases oxygen-carrying capacity. However, the associated rise in blood viscosity may compromise microcirculatory flow and contribute to intrapulmonary shunting during anesthesia. This study investigates sex-specific associations between preoperative hemoglobin concentrations and intraoperative oxygen desaturation events in surgical patients residing at high altitude. METHODS: In this retrospective study, we analyzed data from 8010 high-altitude residents undergoing general anesthesia for noncardiothoracic surgery at People's Hospital of Xizang Autonomous Region between January 2020 and October 2024. The dataset comprised preoperative baseline characteristics, information related to surgery and anesthesia. The primary outcome was intraoperative oxygen desaturation, defined as a peripheral oxygen saturation (Spo2 <90% lasting for >/=1 minute) measured by pulse oximetry in patients receiving mechanical ventilation during general anesthesia. Patients were stratified by sex: male (n = 3622) and female (n = 4388). Nonlinear associations were analyzed using multivariable-adjusted restricted cubic splines, and piecewise logistic regression was used to identify hemoglobin thresholds. RESULTS: Nonlinear associations between preoperative hemoglobin concentrations and intraoperative oxygen desaturation were observed in both sexes. For males, piecewise regression identified a statistical inflection point at 20.6 g/dL (adjusted odds ratio [adjOR] per 1 g/dL increase, 1.50; 95% confidence interval [CI], 1.18-1.92; P = .001). For females, the threshold was notably lower at 14.9 g/dL, above which the risk significantly increased (adjOR per 1 g/dL increase, 1.33; 95% CI, 1.13-1.58; P < .001). However, for males, a clinically significant risk increase was observed starting at 18.0 g/dL (adjOR per 1 g/dL increase, 1.23; 95% CI, 1.05-1.45; P = .012). Sensitivity analyses validated these findings across different definitions of desaturation and imputation methods. CONCLUSIONS: In high-altitude surgical patients receiving mechanical ventilation during general anesthesia, we identified sex-specific hemoglobin thresholds associated with intraoperative oxygen desaturation. While statistical inflection points occur at higher levels, particularly in males, our data suggest that clinical caution is advised when hemoglobin exceeds 18.0 g/dL in males and 14.9 g/dL in females. These findings underscore the rheological risks of higher hemoglobin concentrations and support the adoption of sex-stratified preoperative assessment protocols to optimize perioperative oxygen delivery.

articles.question: 高海拔地区居民血红蛋白代偿性增高，虽可增加携氧能力，但血液粘稠度升高可能影响微循环并导致肺内分流。本研究确定了性别特异性的血红蛋白阈值，有助于术前风险分层和优化围术期氧输送。
articles.conclusion: 在高海拔手术患者中，男性术前血红蛋白超过18.0 g/dL、女性超过14.9 g/dL时，术中氧饱和度降低的风险显著增加。

articles.methods: 高血红蛋白浓度是机体对高海拔缺氧的代偿性适应，理论上可增加携氧能力；然而，伴随的血粘稠度升高可能在麻醉期间损害微循环血流并促进肺内分流。本研究旨在探讨高海拔手术患者术前血红蛋白浓度与术中氧饱和度降低之间的性别特异性关联。
articles.results: 样本量8010例（男3622，女4388）。主要终点为术中氧饱和度降低。在男性和女性中均观察到术前血红蛋白浓度与术中氧饱和度降低呈非线性关联。男性：分段回归确定的统计拐点为20.6 g/dL（每增加1 g/dL的调整后比值比[adjOR]=1.50，95% CI 1.18-1.92，P=0.001），但临床有意义的风险增加始于18.0 g/dL（adjOR=1.23，95% CI 1.05-1.45，P=0.012）。女性：阈值为14.9 g/dL（adjOR=1.33，95% CI 1.13-1.58，P<0.001）。敏感性分析验证了不同去饱和定义和插补方法下的结果。
limitations: 当前可获取内容未提供该数据。
practice: 对于高海拔手术患者，麻醉前应评估血红蛋白水平，男性超过18.0 g/dL、女性超过14.9 g/dL时需警惕术中低氧血症风险。
性别分层术前评估有助于优化围术期氧合管理，可能需考虑降低血红蛋白浓度的干预措施（如放血疗法）或调整麻醉策略。
articles.editor: 中等。研究基于大样本回顾性数据，使用多变量调整和分段回归，统计学关联显著，但观察性研究无法排除混杂因素，结论需前瞻性验证。 过度解读风险：低。作者明确区分了统计拐点与临床阈值（男性临床阈值低于统计拐点），并强调观察性关联而非因果，避免了过度推断。
articles.whyItMatters: 高海拔地区居民血红蛋白代偿性增高，虽可增加携氧能力，但血液粘稠度升高可能影响微循环并导致肺内分流。本研究确定了性别特异性的血红蛋白阈值，有助于术前风险分层和优化围术期氧输送。
articles.background: 高血红蛋白浓度是机体对高海拔缺氧的代偿性适应，理论上可增加携氧能力；然而，伴随的血粘稠度升高可能在麻醉期间损害微循环血流并促进肺内分流。本研究旨在探讨高海拔手术患者术前血红蛋白浓度与术中氧饱和度降低之间的性别特异性关联。

pico.population: High-altitude residents undergoing general anesthesia for noncardiothoracic surgery at People's Hospital of Xizang Autonomous Region between January 2020 and October 2024
pico.intervention: 术前血红蛋白浓度（暴露因素）
pico.comparison: 不同血红蛋白水平（无明确对照组，通过分段回归比较阈值前后）
pico.outcome: Intraoperative oxygen desaturation defined as peripheral oxygen saturation (SpO2 <90% lasting for ≥1 minute) measured by pulse oximetry in patients receiving mechanical ventilation during general anesthesia
